t: You are at the West India Docks on the Isle of Dogs, a series of three docks, quaysides and warehouses built to handle trade with the British West Indies. The first dock opened in 1802. After the docks closed commercially in 1980, Canary Wharf was built around the water, with some of the broadest stretches narrowed. Robert Milligan, a Scottish merchant, ship-owner and slave trader, was the driving force behind building the docks and their original monopoly. He had been a merchant in Kingston, Jamaica. By his death in 1809, one of his partnerships had interests in Jamaican estates that owned 526 enslaved people.
